title: High-voltage lithium-ion battery with a wide operation-temperature range and fast-charging ability
content:

The slow desolvation process and the low ionic conductivity of lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) pose significant challenges, severely limiting their performance in extreme environments. Herein, we propose a weakly-solvated electrolyte system...
